senses.en: a tall pole on which a flag is raised

example.en: A new flag flew above the flagstaff in the schoolyard.
example.zh: 一面新旗在学校操场上的旗杆上方飘扬。

collocations: raise the flag on the flagstaff

senses.en: a style of sad, slow music that developed among African American communities

example.en: She plays guitar in a local blues band.
example.zh: 她在一个当地的布鲁斯乐队弹吉他。

senses.en: a feeling of sadness or depression

example.en: He always sings when he has the blues.
example.zh: 他情绪低落时总会唱歌。

senses.en: an occasion when someone sees something rare or unusual, such as a rare bird or a UFO

example.en: There have been several sightings of the rare whale this year.
example.zh: 今年已有几次目击到这种罕见鲸鱼的记录。

senses.en: a person who rides a bicycle

example.en: A cyclist was riding along the bike path.
example.zh: 一名骑车人正沿着自行车道骑行。

senses.en: a small round orange-yellow fruit with soft flesh

example.en: She spread apricot jam on her toast.
example.zh: 她在吐司上涂了杏子酱。

senses.en: a tree that bears this fruit

example.en: The apricot blossoms open in early spring.
example.zh: 杏花在早春开放。

senses.en: shocking and horrible, often involving death or injury
senses.zh: 可怕的；令人毛骨悚然的

example.en: The movie contains some gruesome scenes.
example.zh: 这部电影包含一些恐怖的场景。

senses.en: an optical instrument for making distant objects appear larger and nearer

example.en: She used a telescope to observe the Moon.
example.zh: 她用望远镜观察月球。

senses.en: to slide or collapse parts into one another, often making something shorter

example.en: The tripod legs telescope into the central column.
example.zh: 三脚架的支腿可缩进中柱。

senses.en: freedom from difficulty or effort

example.en: The ease of the task surprised everyone.
example.zh: 这项任务如此轻松，让大家都感到惊讶。

senses.en: a comfortable state without financial or other hardship

example.en: She lived a life of ease.
example.zh: 她过着安逸的生活。

senses.en: to lessen pain or discomfort

example.en: The medicine eased her pain.
example.zh: 药物减轻了她的疼痛。

senses.en: the main stalk of a plant that supports leaves or flowers

example.en: The rose has a long, green stem.
example.zh: 这朵玫瑰有一根长长的绿色茎。

senses.en: to originate from or be caused by something

example.en: Many health problems stem from poor diet.
example.zh: 许多健康问题源于不良饮食。

senses.en: to stop or restrict the flow or spread of something

example.en: The dam helps stem the flow of water after heavy rain.
example.zh: 这座水坝有助于在暴雨后阻挡水流。

senses.en: happening or paid once every month

example.en: The tenant makes a monthly payment to the landlord.
example.zh: 租客每月向房东付款。

senses.en: once every month

example.en: The committee meets monthly to review progress.
example.zh: 委员会每月开会审查进展。

senses.en: a magazine or other periodical published once a month

example.en: She writes for a literary monthly.
example.zh: 她为一份文学月刊撰稿。

senses.en: to change something, usually to improve it or make it suitable

example.en: The committee voted to modify the proposal before sending it to the board.
example.zh: 委员会投票决定在提交董事会前修改该提案。

senses.en: in grammar, to describe or limit the meaning of another word or phrase

example.en: In the phrase “very cold weather,” the adverb modifies the adjective.
example.zh: 在短语“very cold weather”中，副词修饰形容词。

senses.en: a hand with the fingers tightly closed into the palm

example.en: He clenched his fist in anger.
example.zh: 他愤怒地握紧了拳头。

senses.en: to grip something tightly with the hand

example.en: She fisted the fabric nervously.
example.zh: 她紧张地攥紧了布料。

senses.en: recently; in the recent past

example.en: Have you seen her lately?
example.zh: 你最近见过她吗？

senses.en: to keep something in a particular state or condition

example.en: The nurse maintained a calm tone throughout the conversation.
example.zh: 护士在整个谈话过程中保持平静的语气。

senses.en: to keep something in good condition by checking and repairing it

example.en: The crew maintains the building's heating system every autumn.
example.zh: 工作人员每年秋天维护大楼的供暖系统。

senses.en: to state that something is true, especially when others may disagree

example.en: She maintained that the report was accurate.
example.zh: 她坚持认为这份报告是准确的。

senses.en: not able to do something because of a lack of ability, means, or opportunity

example.en: She was unable to attend the meeting.
example.zh: 她无法参加会议。

senses.en: lacking the physical or mental capacity to do something

example.en: He was unable to lift the box on his own.
example.zh: 他独自无法抬起那个箱子。

senses.en: covered with rust

example.en: The old gate was rusty and hard to open.
example.zh: 那扇旧门生锈了，很难打开。

senses.en: not as good as before because of lack of practice

example.en: My French is a bit rusty after years without practice.
example.zh: 多年不练，我的法语有些生疏了。

senses.en: of a reddish-brown color like rust

example.en: She wore a rusty-colored scarf.
example.zh: 她戴着一条铁锈色的围巾。

senses.en: the ability to bend easily without breaking

example.en: Yoga improves the flexibility of your muscles and joints.
example.zh: 瑜伽能提高肌肉和关节的柔韧性。

senses.en: the quality of being easily adapted to changing circumstances

example.en: Remote work offers employees greater flexibility in their schedules.
example.zh: 远程办公让员工在时间安排上拥有更大的灵活性。

senses.en: a thin soup made from meat, fish, or vegetables cooked in water

example.en: She served a warm bowl of chicken broth.
example.zh: 她端上了一碗温热的鸡汤。

senses.en: a person or farm that grows plants or crops

example.en: Local growers supply fresh fruit to the market.
example.zh: 当地种植户向市场供应新鲜水果。

senses.en: a plant that grows in a specified way

example.en: Tomatoes are fast growers in warm weather.
example.zh: 西红柿在温暖的天气里生长迅速。

senses.en: a learning process in which behavior is shaped by repeated stimuli
senses.zh: 条件作用；条件反射训练

example.en: Pavlov's experiments on dogs demonstrated classical conditioning.
example.zh: 巴甫洛夫的狗实验证明了经典条件作用。

senses.en: physical training to improve fitness or performance

example.en: Athletes need good physical conditioning before the season.
example.zh: 运动员在赛季前需要良好的体能训练。

senses.en: the state of having two opposite poles, such as positive and negative electric charges

example.en: Check the polarity of the battery before inserting it.
example.zh: 装入电池前先检查一下极性。

senses.en: a sharp contrast or opposition between two qualities or tendencies

example.en: The debate revealed a clear polarity between the two positions.
example.zh: 这场辩论显示出两种立场之间的明显对立。

senses.en: increasing in size, amount or degree

example.en: There is a growing interest in healthy eating.
example.zh: 人们对健康饮食的兴趣日益浓厚。

senses.en: developing and becoming more mature

example.en: Growing children need plenty of sleep.
example.zh: 成长中的孩子需要充足的睡眠。

senses.en: the process of growing; the cultivation of plants

example.en: The growing of vegetables is easier in a warm climate.
example.zh: 在温暖的气候里种植蔬菜更容易。

senses.en: a common English surname

example.en: Mr. Wilson is our new history teacher.
example.zh: 威尔逊先生是我们的新历史老师。

senses.en: a male given name

example.en: Wilson has worked at the company for five years.
example.zh: 威尔逊在这家公司工作五年了。

senses.en: clever at deceiving people to get what one wants

example.en: The wily fox escaped every trap the hunters set.
example.zh: 那只狡猾的狐狸躲开了猎人设下的每一个陷阱。

senses.en: to laugh or make a loud sharp unpleasant sound, like a hen

example.en: The witch cackled at her own joke.
example.zh: 女巫对自己开的笑话咯咯大笑。

senses.en: a loud sharp laugh or the cry of a hen

example.en: We heard the hen's cackle from the yard.
example.zh: 我们听到院子里母鸡的咯咯叫声。

senses.en: unable to pay debts owed

example.en: The company was declared insolvent last year.
example.zh: 这家公司去年被宣告破产。

senses.en: a person who cannot pay their debts

example.en: Insolvents must declare their assets to the court.
example.zh: 无力偿债者必须向法院申报其资产。

senses.en: covered with or full of soft wet land like a swamp

example.en: The swampy ground made walking difficult.
example.zh: 湿软的沼泽地使行走变得困难。

senses.en: not appropriate to the standards of a profession or workplace
senses.zh: 不专业的；违反职业规范的

example.en: Yelling at a client is unprofessional behavior.
example.zh: 对客户大喊大叫是不专业的行为。

senses.en: happening as a minor or chance result of something else; not essential

example.en: The extra costs are incidental to running the business.
example.zh: 这些额外费用是经营业务的附带成本。

senses.en: (usually plural) minor expenses in addition to the main cost

example.en: Hotel incidentals like phone calls added up quickly.
example.zh: 酒店里打电话之类的杂费很快就累积起来。

senses.en: to move quickly and lightly from place to place

example.en: Butterflies flitted among the flowers.
example.zh: 蝴蝶在花丛间飞来飞去。

senses.en: a quick, light movement

example.en: The bird's flit between branches was hard to follow.
example.zh: 鸟儿在树枝间轻快的飞掠难以追踪。

senses.en: made or done badly, with poor materials or workmanship

example.en: The shoddy construction caused the roof to leak.
example.zh: 劣质的施工导致屋顶漏水。

senses.en: cheap wool fiber made from old rags

example.en: The blanket was woven partly from shoddy.
example.zh: 这条毯子部分是用再生毛织成的。

senses.en: easy to understand, see, or hear

example.en: The instructions are clear enough for beginners.
example.zh: 这些说明对初学者来说足够清楚。

senses.en: transparent or free from clouds, marks, or blockages
senses.zh: 透明的；晴朗的；无污迹的

example.en: The sky became clear after the rain.
example.zh: 雨后天空变得晴朗了。

senses.en: to remove things that block, dirty, or fill a place

example.en: Please clear the dishes from the table.
example.zh: 请把桌上的盘子收走。

senses.en: to pass over or through something without touching it

example.en: The ball cleared the fence easily.
example.zh: 球轻松越过了栅栏。

senses.en: a thick tropical forest with many tangled plants

example.en: We heard parrots calling in the jungle.
example.zh: 我们听到鹦鹉在丛林里鸣叫。

senses.en: a confusing or untidy mass of things
senses.zh: 杂乱的一堆；复杂混乱的局面

example.en: The cables formed a jungle behind the desk.
example.zh: 桌子后面的电缆乱成一团。

senses.en: ruin, death, or something very bad that is going to happen

example.en: A sense of doom hung over the city.
example.zh: 一种大难临头的感觉笼罩着整座城市。

senses.en: to make someone or something certain to fail or be destroyed

example.en: The project was doomed to fail without more funding.
example.zh: 没有更多资金，这个项目注定要失败。

senses.en: to judge or condemn someone, especially to a bad fate

example.en: The scandal doomed his political career.
example.zh: 那桩丑闻断送了他的政治生涯。

senses.en: to limit or restrict someone or something

example.en: Lack of funding constrained their research.
example.zh: 资金不足限制了他们的研究。

senses.en: to force someone to act in a certain way

example.en: He felt constrained to apologize.
example.zh: 他感到不得不道歉。

senses.en: to make things or people into one whole; to bring together

example.en: The new leader tried to unify the two departments.
example.zh: 新领导试图统一这两个部门。

senses.en: to become one single thing or system

example.en: The two companies will unify under one brand next year.
example.zh: 两家公司明年将在同一品牌下合为一体。

senses.en: a soft sweet creamy dessert, often made with milk, sugar and flavouring
senses.zh: 布丁（一种软滑的甜点心）

example.en: She had chocolate pudding for dessert.
example.zh: 她餐后甜点吃了巧克力布丁。

senses.en: (British) the dessert course of a meal, in general

example.en: What's for pudding tonight?
example.zh: 今晚的甜点是什么？

senses.en: not deep; having little distance from top to bottom

example.en: The river is shallow enough to walk across here.
example.zh: 这条河在这里浅得可以步行蹚过去。

senses.en: not showing serious thought or deep feeling

example.en: He dismissed the criticism as shallow and uninformed.
example.zh: 他认为那些批评肤浅且缺乏了解，不予理会。

senses.en: an area of water that is not deep (usually plural)

example.en: The children played in the shallows near the shore.
example.zh: 孩子们在近岸的浅水处玩耍。

senses.en: to become or make something less deep

example.en: The lake shallows toward its eastern edge.
example.zh: 湖的东部边缘逐渐变浅。

senses.en: the quality of being logically or factually sound

example.en: The validity of her argument convinced everyone in the room.
example.zh: 她的论证的正确性说服了房间里的每一个人。

senses.en: the state of being legally or officially acceptable

example.en: The lawyer challenged the validity of the contract.
example.zh: 律师质疑了合同的有效性。

senses.en: the period during which something remains effective

example.en: The visa has a validity of ninety days.
example.zh: 该签证的有效期为九十天。

senses.en: a set of keys used for typing on a computer or other machine

example.en: Please type your password on the keyboard.
example.zh: 请在键盘上输入你的密码。

senses.en: the keys of a piano or organ

example.en: She ran her fingers across the piano keyboard.
example.zh: 她的手指在钢琴键盘上滑过。

senses.en: to enter information by using a keyboard

example.en: The clerk keyboarded the data into the system.
example.zh: 职员把数据键入系统。

senses.en: a machine that converts mechanical energy into electricity

example.en: The hospital has a backup generator in case of a power cut.
example.zh: 医院有一台备用发电机，以防停电。

senses.en: a device or process that produces something such as gas, steam, or signals

example.en: The system uses a random number generator to create secure passwords.
example.zh: 该系统使用随机数发生器来生成安全密码。

senses.en: a large fortified building where rulers or nobles once lived

example.en: The old castle stands on a hill above the town.
example.zh: 那座古老的城堡矗立在镇子上方的山上。

senses.en: in chess, to move the king two squares toward a rook while the rook moves next to it

example.en: He castled early to protect his king.
example.zh: 他很早就王车易位来保护自己的王。

senses.en: a colorless, odorless gas that makes up about 78% of the air and is found in all living things
senses.zh: 氮（一种无色无味的气体，约占空气的78%）

example.en: Nitrogen is the most abundant gas in the Earth's atmosphere.
example.zh: 氮是地球大气中含量最多的气体。

senses.en: a large slow-moving mass of ice formed from snow

example.en: The glacier moves down the valley a few centimeters each day.
example.zh: 冰川每天沿山谷向下移动几厘米。

senses.en: material used to keep heat, sound, or electricity from passing through

example.en: Good insulation keeps the house warm in winter.
example.zh: 良好的隔热层能让房子在冬天保持温暖。

senses.en: the state of being separated or protected from others

example.en: The thick walls provided insulation from the city noise.
example.zh: 厚厚的墙壁隔绝了城市的噪音。

senses.en: extremely great or impressive; remarkable

example.en: The young pianist showed phenomenal talent at her first concert.
example.zh: 这位年轻钢琴家在首场音乐会上展现了惊人的才华。

senses.en: the amount of rain that falls in an area or period

example.en: This region gets heavy rainfall in summer.
example.zh: 这个地区夏季降雨量很大。

senses.en: darkness or dimness

example.en: The room was in gloom after sunset.
example.zh: 日落之后房间里一片昏暗。

senses.en: a feeling of sadness or hopelessness

example.en: The bad news spread gloom through the office.
example.zh: 坏消息让办公室里弥漫着忧郁的气氛。

senses.en: trying to weaken or overthrow a government or established system

example.en: The film was criticized as subversive by some politicians.
example.zh: 这部电影被一些政客批评具有颠覆性。

senses.en: a person who tries to weaken or overthrow a government or system

example.en: The government accused the group of being subversives.
example.zh: 政府指控该组织成员是颠覆分子。

senses.en: a person who saves someone from drowning or danger

example.en: The lifeguard was a real lifesaver when the swimmer began to sink.
example.zh: 游泳者开始下沉时，救生员真是救了他一命。

senses.en: something that provides crucial help in a difficult situation
senses.zh: 救急的东西；雪中送炭之物

example.en: That phone charger was a lifesaver on the long trip.
example.zh: 长途旅行中那个手机充电器帮了大忙。

senses.en: extremely small

example.en: The insect was a minuscule speck on the leaf.
example.zh: 那只昆虫只是叶子上的一个极小的斑点。

senses.en: a lowercase letter, or a small medieval handwriting style
senses.zh: 小写字母；小写体（中世纪书法）

example.en: The scribe wrote the text in minuscule.
example.zh: 抄写员用小写体书写了这段文字。

senses.en: with a meaning that is mysterious or hard to understand

example.en: She left a cryptic message on my desk.
example.zh: 她在我的桌上留了一条隐晦的信息。

senses.en: a tiny particle of solid or liquid matter in the air or a liquid

example.en: The factory installed filters to reduce particulates in the air.
example.zh: 工厂安装了过滤器以减少空气中的颗粒物。

senses.en: made of or relating to small separate particles

example.en: Particulate pollution worsens air quality in cities.
example.zh: 颗粒物污染使城市空气质量恶化。

senses.en: better than all others; beyond comparison
senses.zh: 无与伦比的；无可匹敌的

example.en: The restaurant is known for its unmatched service.
example.zh: 这家餐厅以其无与伦比的服务而闻名。

senses.en: not paired or matched with another

example.en: One unmatched sock was left in the drawer.
example.zh: 抽屉里剩下一只不成对的袜子。

senses.en: plural of engineer; people who design or build machines, structures or systems

example.en: The engineers solved the bridge design problem.
example.zh: 工程师们解决了桥梁设计的问题。

senses.en: skillfully plans and arranges something (third person of engineer)
senses.zh: 策划；精心安排（engineer的第三人称单数）

example.en: He engineers every detail of the campaign.
example.zh: 他精心策划活动的每一个细节。
